Hi Laura,

Congrats on getting the initial offer draft into the portal — quick note from marketplace ops before we approve the listing. For co-sell enablement and the public product page we need: a short trust/evidence pack (SOC2, data residency statements, any HSM/KMS notes), concrete usage examples (1–3 short bullets per industry), and a single-slide field enablement summary we can share with the AWS sellers.

Can you provide a consolidated PDF and a sample usage CSV by EOD Friday? Also if you have a draft co-sell playbook or seller talking points we can use those in the seller enablement call next week.

Thanks — I can schedule the enablement call once we have assets.

Hi Sam — attaching the consolidated trust pack, sample usage CSV and a draft co-sell playbook slide for seller enablement. We kept the public-facing product page language tight (see excerpt below) and included a one-liner about SLA-backed Dedicated capacity for field talking points.

Product page blurb (Security & Compliance):
"SOC 2 Type II audited; encryption in transit and at rest; optional customer‑managed KMS for private deployments and on‑prem installations. Data residency and retention controls configurable per account."

Field enablement talking points (excerpt):
- SLA-backed Dedicated capacity for predictable throughput and low, consistent latency.
- Bring‑your‑own‑KMS available for regulated environments; HSM integrations supported.
- Typical FinServ use case: low-latency document scoring for risk workflows (pin model versions to maintain auditability).
- Typical ISV use case: threaded assistants and code tools using Dedicated pools to optimize cost.

Next steps: please confirm whether these artifacts satisfy marketplace requirements; if yes, can we lock a 30-minute seller enablement slot next week (Mon/Tue preferred)? Emily — I copied you so the ACME field team can attend the enablement session if helpful.

Attachments: redwood_awsmkt_trust-pack_v1.pdf, sample-usage-examples.csv, co-sell_playbook_draft.docx

Thanks,
